DGSchedSim is a trace driven simulator that can be used to evaluate scheduling algorithms in desktop grid systems; the simulator can be used in combination with the CIET algorithm to assess scheduling policies in desktop grids; and the CIET algorithm is an efficient tool that computes the ideal execution time of a cluster of heterogeneous machines to process an application comprised of a set T of equal sized independent tasks.

(i) the CIET algorithm can be used as a reference for the ideal wall-clock times of a given application in a desktop grid system; and (ii) FCFS and Minmax scheduling algorithms combined with a centrally checkpointed application achieve a performance close to the 50% of the CIET.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of a simulator that permits to evaluate scheduling algorithms and policies for task farming applications in desktop grid environments.
the design and evaluation of scheduling algorithms in desktop grids.
the design of scheduling algorithms for task farming applications in heterogeneous desktop grid environments.
